User request: Rewrite this spreadsheet instruction more clearly without changing the formula: Total is calculated with =SUM(A1:A3).

content.text:
Draft/Notes:
- To calculate the Total, enter =SUM(A1:A3) — this adds the values in cells A1 through A3.

Note: I assume A1:A3 contain the numeric values you want to add; if they contain text or blanks, the result may differ.
